description: Implementation of the ReuseAllocatorBase class managing memory blocks, including allocation, freeing, merging, and printing allocation info.

classes.name: ReuseAllocatorBase::MemoryBlock
classes.description: Represents a memory block with methods for merging, checking fulfillment, and allocation.

methods.name: ReuseAllocatorBase::MemoryBlock::Merge
methods.description: Merges two adjacent memory blocks if they are contiguous.

methods.name: ReuseAllocatorBase::MemoryBlock::CanFulfill
methods.description: Checks if the block can fulfill a request of a given size and alignment.

methods.name: ReuseAllocatorBase::MemoryBlock::Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a sub-block from the memory block, either from the front or the end.

methods.name: ReuseAllocatorBase::PrintAllocations
methods.description: Prints current allocations and free blocks statistics.

methods.name: ReuseAllocatorBase::TryFree
methods.description: Attempts to free a memory block.

methods.name: ReuseAllocatorBase::ReuseAllocatorBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the allocator with fallback, capacity, and limits.

methods.name: ReuseAllocatorBase::ExpandToFit
methods.description: Expands memory to fit a requested size and alignment.

methods.name: ReuseAllocatorBase::AddFreeBlock
methods.description: Adds and merges a free memory block into the free list.

methods.name: ReuseAllocatorBase::RemoveFreeBlock
methods.description: Removes a free block from the free list.
